# Furkan Bekdemir

> Psychiatry resident and computational psychiatry researcher at Ondokuz Mayıs University, Samsun. Belief updating, sensory attenuation, and instrumentation for psychiatric research.

ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7236-5776
Code: https://github.com/frknbkdmr
Full text of every page: https://furkanbekdemir.com/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Computational psychiatry and instrumentation](https://furkanbekdemir.com/): Psychiatry resident at Ondokuz Mayıs University working in computational psychiatry and computational neuroscience: belief updating, sensory attenuation, and the instruments built to measure them.
- [Research](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/): Belief updating and sensory attenuation in schizophrenia, akathisia as active inference, effort-based decision making in multiple sclerosis, and uncertainty processing in generalized anxiety disorder.
- [Akathisia as active inference](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/akathisia-active-inference): An active inference account of akathisia, locating the disorder in how bodily prediction errors are turned into action rather than in the motor system. Concept note in preparation.
- [State anxiety and uncertainty processing in generalized anxiety disorder](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/anxiety-hgf): A Hierarchical Gaussian Filter study of belief updating in generalized anxiety disorder. Published abstract, Turkish Journal of Psychiatry, 2026.
- [Belief updating and sensory attenuation in schizophrenia](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/belief-updating-schizophrenia): Residency thesis testing two accounts of delusion in the same participants: belief revision on too little evidence, and failure to attenuate self-generated sensation.
- [Effort and reward in multiple sclerosis](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/effort-ms): Separating fatigue from depression in multiple sclerosis by modelling effort-based decisions, with the Department of Neurology. What the published literature has and has not settled.
- [Personality, impulsivity and gambling-related cognitions in gambling disorder](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/gambling-cognitions): A clinical study of personality traits, impulsivity and gambling-related cognitions in patients with gambling disorder. Published abstract, Turkish Journal of Psychiatry, 2025.
- [Instruments and code](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools): Behavioural paradigms, hardware, and analysis code built for psychiatric research: force-matching devices, beads tasks, and HGF modelling.
- [Beads task](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools/beads-task): A PsychoPy implementation of the beads task that logs every draw, written so the data can be modelled rather than reduced to draws-to-decision.
- [Force-matching device](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools/force-matching): A single-channel force-matching rig built in-house for the force-matching task, calibrated against dead weights across the full range the task uses.
- [GÖRÜNGÜ](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools/gorungu): Optical mark recognition and automatic scoring for paper psychiatric assessment forms, so that scale batteries stop being typed in by hand. Python, OpenCV, MIT.
- [HGF analysis pipeline](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools/hgf-pipeline): Model fitting, parameter and model recovery, and Bayesian model selection with TAPAS. The recovery simulations ran before confirmatory collection and changed which outcomes the study reports.
- [Building the force-matching rig](https://furkanbekdemir.com/log/force-matching): A development log for the force-matching device: choosing which published lineage to follow, rewriting the calibration tool, and what the calibration run showed.
- [CV](https://furkanbekdemir.com/cv): Curriculum vitae of Furkan Bekdemir, MD, psychiatry resident and computational psychiatry researcher at Ondokuz Mayıs University, Samsun.
- [Notlar](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notlar): Hesaplamalı psikiyatri, hesaplamalı sinirbilim ve öngörücü kodlama üzerine Türkçe notlar. Yetmiş terimlik bir Türkçe karşılık sözlüğü ve klinik okura yazılmış giriş yazıları.
- [Duyusal azaltım ve kuvvet eşleştirme görevi](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notlar/duyusal-azaltim): Duyusal azaltımın klinik okur için açıklaması: kendi ürettiğimiz dokunuşu neden zayıf hissederiz, kuvvet eşleştirme görevi bunu nasıl sayıya çevirir, şizofreni, fonksiyonel hareket bozukluğu ve yorgunlukta ne bulunmuştur.
- [Hiyerarşik Gauss filtresi nedir, ne işe yarar](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notlar/hgf-nedir): Hesaplamalı psikiyatride sık kullanılan Hiyerarşik Gauss Filtresinin klinik okur için açıklaması: modelin parametreleri ne ölçer, model karşılaştırması neden zorunludur ve bir hesaplamalı bulguya ne zaman güvenilir.
- [Bayesçi beyin, öngörü hatası ve psikiyatrik belirti](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notlar/ongoru-hatasi-ve-hassasiyet): Bayesçi beyin ve öngörücü kodlama çerçevesinin klinik okur için açıklaması: öngörü hatası ne demek, hassasiyet neyi belirler, psikozdan otizme ve anksiyeteye kadar hangi belirtiye nasıl bağlanıyor ve çerçevenin kapsayıcılığı neden aynı zamanda en büyük itirazı.
- [Şizofrenide inanç güncelleme ve aceleci karar](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notlar/sizofrenide-inanc-guncelleme): Sonuca atlama yanlılığı, beads görevi ve hesaplamalı modellerin şizofrenide inanç güncelleme hakkında ne gösterdiği. Meta-analizler ne kadarını destekliyor, hangi bulgu tanıya hangisi belirtiye bağlanıyor ve ölçümün güvenilirliği nerede duruyor.
- [Hesaplamalı psikiyatri terimleri](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notlar/terimler): Hesaplamalı psikiyatri ve hesaplamalı sinirbilimden yetmiş terimin Türkçe karşılığı, her biri için kaynak durumuyla: elli ikisinde terimin Türkçe kullanıldığı akademik bir kaynak var, on sekizinde yerleşik karşılık bulunamadı.
- [Notes](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notes): Notes on computational psychiatry written for clinical readers: the Hierarchical Gaussian Filter, sensory attenuation and the force-matching task, and what the evidence on belief updating in psychosis actually supports.
- [Belief updating in psychosis and hasty decisions](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notes/belief-updating-in-psychosis): What the jumping-to-conclusions bias, the beads task and computational models actually show about belief updating in schizophrenia: how much the meta-analyses support, which findings track diagnosis and which track symptoms, and where the measurement stands.
- [The Hierarchical Gaussian Filter, for clinical readers](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notes/hierarchical-gaussian-filter): The Hierarchical Gaussian Filter explained for clinical readers: what the parameters measure, why model comparison is not optional, and when a computational finding can be trusted.
- [Sensory attenuation and the force-matching task](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notes/sensory-attenuation): Why self-produced touch feels weaker, how the force-matching task turns that into a number, and what has been found in schizophrenia, functional movement disorder and fatigue.
